Promoter and his servants, etc., to afford facilities to Inspector and other officers. Section 14. Inspection of aerial ropeway before opening. Section 15. Section 26. Proceedings in case of inability or insolvency of promoter. Section 27. Lease of aerial ropeway by local authority. Section 28. Review of orders under section 10 or 21. Section 29. Returns. Section 39. Protection of road railways, tramways and water-ways. Section 40. Acquisition of land by promoter. Section 41. Limitation of claims for damage to animals or goods. Section 42. Application of Act to certain private aerial ropeways. Section 43. Inspectors, officers and servants to be public servants. Section 44. Protection of persons acting in good faith under this Act. Section 45. Power of State Government to make rules.
